Checkup

Checkup is a feature to make it easier to assess server requirements and optimal configurations.

Using

It is possible to use the class to detect problems in the environment where the application is running, like this:

<?php use Inphinit\Diagnostics\Checkup; $app->action('GET', '/checkup', function () { $check = new Checkup(); $errors = $check->getErrors(); echo implode("<br>\n", $errors); $warnings = $check->getWarnings(); echo implode("<br>\n", $warnings); });

When creating a new project, the /checkup in main.php route will already be configured and working to determine the conditions of the environment in which the application is running. It's possible to move the route to a context with authentication or limit it to the scope of an private host. Related files:

  • system/
    • Controllers/
      • HomeController.php
    • views/
      • checkup.php

These files can be removed or completely recreated; the approach presented is just a sample of basic usage.

Message Notes
Unexpected value in max_execution_time=<value> (interpreted as <value>) Note: Web only
Unlimited max_execution_time is unsafe in Web context Note: Web only
Invalid value in entry memory_limit=<value>
Unlimited memory_limit is unsafe in Web context Note: Web only
Invalid value in entry post_max_size=<value> Note: Web only
Invalid value in entry upload_max_filesize=<value> Note: Web only
post_max_size=<value> is smaller than upload_max_filesize=<value> Note: Web only
Unexpected value in max_file_uploads=<value> (interpreted as <value>) Note: Web only
random_bytes() unavailable, enable the Mcrypt Extension to use as fallback Note: PHP 7+ Only
random_bytes() unavailable; check disable_functions Note: PHP 5 Only
No such directory: ./storage
./storage directory requires write permissions
Disable the deprecated magic_quotes_gpc Note: PHP 5 & 7 only
Disable the deprecated always_populate_raw_post_data Note: PHP 5 only
In production environment, the display_errors must be disabled Note: Production Environment Only
